feature.name: Recipient document signing page
feature.description: Documenso /sign/:token flow: link resolution and gating, access auth, PDF render with assigned fields, per-field dialogs and signature pad, action re-auth, rejection, completion (with optional access 2FA), CSC/TSP remote signing, and the terminal complete/waiting/expired/rejected pages. Covers both V1 (document-signing-page-view-v1) and V2 (envelope) renderers where they diverge.

states.name: Link not found
states.description: Token missing, unknown, recipient missing, or document still DRAFT. Loader throws 404; generic not-found page.
states.trigger: GET /sign/:token with invalid token or draft doc

states.name: Waiting for turn
states.description: Sequential signing and it is not this recipient's turn. 'Waiting for Your Turn' copy, Return Home link.

states.name: Waiting, owner edit link
states.description: Logged-in user is document owner/team member: link 'Were you trying to edit this document instead?' replaces Return Home.

states.name: Rejected terminal page
states.description: Recipient previously rejected. Title badge, XCircle, 'You have rejected this document', owner notified copy, Return Home if logged in.

states.name: Deadline expired page
states.description: Recipient expiry passed. TimerOff icon, 'Signing Deadline Expired', contact-owner copy.

states.name: Document cancelled
states.description: Document deleted or status REJECTED (by another recipient). SigningCard3D with recipient name, red Clock8 'Document Cancelled', '"{title}" is no longer available to sign'. Logged-in: Go Back Home; anonymous: Documenso promo link.

states.name: Already signed redirect
states.description: Recipient already SIGNED or document COMPLETED: loader redirects straight to /complete. Reopening the email link after signing is common.

states.name: Custom redirect URL
states.description: Sender configured documentMeta.redirectUrl: after completion (or when already signed) recipient is sent off-site instead of /complete. No Documenso confirmation shown; ambiguity: no interstitial exists.

states.name: Logged-in app header
states.description: V1 renders AuthenticatedHeader above the signing page when a session exists; anonymous recipients get no header.

states.name: Auth required, has account
states.description: Access auth ACCOUNT required and viewer is anonymous or logged in as a different email. 'You need to be logged in as {email}', Login button. Also covers wrong-account case.

states.name: Auth required, no account
states.description: Same gate but recipient email has no account: button reads 'Sign up' and deep-links /signup#email=.

states.name: Switching account
states.description: Login/Sign up button in loading state while authClient.signOut runs before redirect.

states.name: Sign-out failed toast
states.description: Destructive toast 'Something went wrong / We were unable to log you out at this time' (10s).

states.name: Status page gated by auth
states.description: /complete, /expired, /rejected also render DocumentSigningAuthPageView (no emailHasAccount, so button says Sign up) when access auth fails. Ambiguity: label may be wrong for existing users.

states.name: PDF loading
states.description: 80vh centered spinner at 50% opacity while the PDF bytes are fetched and pdf.js initialises.

states.name: PDF load error
states.description: 'Something went wrong while loading the document. Please try again or contact our support.' plus error toast. No retry button exists.
states.trigger: fetch PDF non-200 or pdf.js failure

states.name: Document loaded
states.description: Happy path: title, sender line ('{sender} has invited you to sign'), PDF pages, field overlays, side panel or mobile widget.

states.name: No document selected
states.description: V2 fallback 'No document selected' when currentEnvelopeItem is null.

states.name: Page render error
states.description: A single page image fails to render (imageLoadingState 'error') while the rest of the doc is fine.

states.name: Multi-file selector
states.description: V2 envelopes with more than one file show a horizontal scrollable file tab strip with per-file remaining-field counts and selected state.

states.name: Branded header
states.description: Team branding enabled: custom logo above title, RecipientBranding CSS applied; 'Powered by' badge toggled by hidePoweredBy.

states.name: Long title truncated
states.description: Title truncates at 20rem/30rem with title attribute; sender name truncates; completed-page badge truncates at 10rem/20rem.
states.trigger: Long document title or sender name

states.name: Other signers' fields shown
states.description: Fields already completed by other recipients render read-only with recipient tooltip; this recipient cannot interact.

states.name: Panel fields remaining
states.description: Sidebar/widget shows role title, 'N Fields Remaining' pill, Full Name input, Signature slot, and a 'Next Field' primary button.

states.name: All required fields done
states.description: Button flips to 'Complete' (or Approve / Mark as viewed), helper copy 'Please complete the document once reviewed', progress bar full.

states.name: Role copy variants
states.description: VIEWER (View Document / Mark as viewed, no form, no progress bar), APPROVER (Approve Document / Approve), ASSISTANT (Assist Document / Complete). Sender line and confirm dialog copy change per role.

states.name: Not your turn, disabled
states.description: V1 passes disabled={!isRecipientsTurn} to the Complete button as a defensive state (loader normally redirects to /waiting first).

states.name: Next Field pending tooltip
states.description: Clicking 'Next Field' with required fields empty: page scrolls to the first pending field, orange 'Click to insert field' tooltip appears; confirm dialog will not open.

states.name: Next field on another file
states.description: Next pending field lives in a different envelope item: file switches, then scroll after 150ms; falls back to data-scroll-to-page when page is virtualised.

states.name: Progress bar partial
states.description: 4px bar width = completed required / total required; 100% when no required fields. Hidden for VIEWER and ASSISTANT on mobile widget.

states.name: Mobile widget collapsed
states.description: Fixed bottom bar (<lg): chevron, role title, remaining count, small Complete/Next Field button, progress bar; form hidden.

states.name: Mobile widget expanded
states.description: Chevron toggles slide-in panel with Full Name + Signature form (max-height calc(100dvh-2rem) on V1). Pre-expanded for assistants.

states.name: Sidebar collapsed
states.description: V2 desktop sidebar collapses to 12px rail with PanelLeftOpen button; content invisible.

states.name: Name input locked
states.description: Embed context isNameLocked/isEmailLocked or recipient.name already set: Full Name / email inputs rendered disabled.

states.name: Cancel back disabled
states.description: V1 Cancel button (navigate(-1)) disabled when window.history.length <= 1, i.e. link opened in a fresh tab, which is the normal case.

states.name: Signature slot empty
states.description: Panel signature box shows animated pen-stroke SVG (pathLength draws over 2s, spring scale on hover) inviting a click.

states.name: Signature slot filled
states.description: SignatureRender canvas draws the typed (Caveat font, auto-fit) or image signature; clicking reopens the pad with value preloaded.

states.name: Panel disabled while submitting
states.description: V1 fieldset disabled and signature slot at 50% opacity/pointer-events none while completion is pending.

states.name: Field empty
states.description: Uninserted field: recipient-colored box with placeholder text (e.g. 'Signature' in signature font, field label). Full-size invisible submit button on top.

states.name: Field hover
states.description: group-hover changes placeholder text to recipient-green / primary.

states.name: Field flagged required
states.description: Validation pass: unsigned required fields recolor to orange ('isValidating') so the user can spot what is left.

states.name: Field inserting
states.description: Absolute overlay with spinning Loader covering the field while signFieldWithToken / envelope.field.sign is pending.

states.name: Field inserted
states.description: Value rendered (text, number, date, name, email, initials, selected options) with left/center/right alignment from fieldMeta.

states.name: Inserted hover Remove
states.description: Hovering an inserted (non-checkbox, non-readonly) field shows orange tooltip 'Remove' (plus optional tooltipText); click clears the field.

states.name: Checkbox clear button
states.description: Inserted checkbox field shows a dark X button below on hover (opacity 0 -> 100) to clear all values.

states.name: Field removing
states.description: Same Loader overlay while removeSignedFieldWithToken is pending.

states.name: Field remove error
states.description: Destructive toast 'Error / An error occurred while removing the signature.' Field stays inserted.

states.name: Field sign error
states.description: Destructive toast 'An error occurred while signing the document/field.' Field reverts to empty. UNAUTHORIZED is rethrown to the reauth dialog instead.

states.name: Read-only prefilled date
states.description: DATE fields are prefilled client-side with today's date in the document timezone/format, marked readOnly, rendered in the readOnly color with no click or remove affordance.

states.name: Radio/checkbox label pill
states.description: Radio and checkbox fields with fieldMeta.label show a label pill above the field; border/bg changes when inserted (primary border, documenso-200 bg).

states.name: Typed signature auto-shrink
states.description: Typed signature text shrinks from 2rem down to 0.8rem via ResizeObserver until it fits; break-all for very long names.

states.name: Signature signed image vs text
states.description: Three-state field: 'empty' placeholder, 'signed-image' (object-contain img with alt 'Signature for {name}'), 'signed-text' (Caveat font centered).

states.name: Signature dialog open
states.description: 'Sign as {name} ({email})' / 'Sign Signature Field' dialog: Draw/Type/Upload tabs, aspect-ratio pad, legal disclosure text, Cancel + Sign.
states.trigger: Click empty signature field with no stored signature

states.name: Drawing in progress
states.description: While pointer is pressed, color picker, Clear and Undo fade to opacity 0 / pointer-events none; strokes render live via perfect-freehand. touch-action none.

states.name: Signature too small
states.description: checkSignatureValidity fails: red 'Signature is too small' bottom-left, value not emitted, Sign stays disabled. Common on phones with a tiny scribble.

states.name: Valid drawing with Undo
states.description: Valid signature with lines present: Undo (last stroke) button appears bottom-left, Clear Signature bottom-right.

states.name: Pad cleared
states.description: Clear Signature wipes canvas, resets lines, emits '' so Sign disables again.

states.name: Ink color picker
states.description: Top-right Select with Black/Red/Blue/Green swatches; only black gets dark-mode inversion. Typed tab has no color (commented out).

states.name: Type tab prefilled
states.description: Type tab auto-fills the recipient's full name in 7xl Caveat once (until dirty). Value trims leading spaces.
states.trigger: Switch to Type with fullName and empty value

states.name: Type tab empty
states.description: No name known: 'Type your signature' placeholder at 4xl.

states.name: Upload tab empty
states.description: Full-pad button with UploadCloud icon and 'Upload Signature'; hidden file input accept=image/*. No drag-and-drop zone exists (ambiguity: taxonomy drag-hover not implemented).

states.name: Upload loaded, zoom/pan
states.description: Image aspect-fit on canvas, grab/grabbing cursor for drag, Zoom in/out buttons (0.25x-4x, disabled at bounds), 'Upload New Image' link.

states.name: Upload wrong file type
states.description: Destructive toast 'Unable to upload image / Please upload a valid image file.'

states.name: Upload too large
states.description: Toast 'The image must be smaller than 5MB.'

states.name: Upload invalid or failed
states.description: Zero-dimension SVG -> 'This image is invalid'; decode failure -> 'The image could not be loaded. Please try again.'

states.name: Uploaded image too small
states.description: After zooming out or panning off-canvas, validity check fails: 'Signature is too small', value cleared.

states.name: Signature methods restricted
states.description: Sender disables draw/type/upload: only enabled tabs render; single-method shows one tab. All disabled renders nothing (throws 'No signature enabled' in state init; ambiguity).

states.name: Sign button disabled
states.description: Sign / Next button disabled until a valid non-empty signature exists on the active tab.

states.name: Typed signature not allowed
states.description: Stored typed signature applied to a doc where typed is disabled: toast 'Typed signatures are not allowed. Please draw your signature.'

states.name: Reuse existing signature
states.description: Signature already in context (account signature, prior field, or panel slot): clicking a signature field inserts immediately without the dialog.

states.name: Dark mode canvas inversion
states.description: Canvases use dark:hue-rotate-180 dark:invert so black ink reads on dark backgrounds; colored ink is not inverted.

states.name: Text dialog default
states.description: Dialog titled by fieldMeta.label or 'Enter Text', textarea with placeholder, Cancel/Enter.

states.name: Text required error
states.description: Submitting empty: red border + ring on textarea, FormMessage 'Text is required'.

states.name: Characters remaining
states.description: '# characters remaining' counter when fieldMeta.characterLimit > 0 and no error. Ambiguity: no client-side block when exceeded.

states.name: Number validation errors
states.description: 'Please enter a valid number', too_small/too_big against minValue/maxValue, or 'Number needs to be formatted as {format}'. Red input styling.

states.name: Checkbox rule dialog
states.description: Options list with preselected indices; description states rule ('Select at least/exactly/at most N options').

states.name: Checkbox rule violated
states.description: Rule not met on Confirm: description text turns destructive; unselecting all is allowed for optional fields.

states.name: Dropdown picker
states.description: Top-anchored CommandDialog with search input 'Select an option' and Options group; selecting an item inserts.

states.name: Dropdown no results
states.description: CommandEmpty 'No results found.' (untranslated string in code).

states.name: Dialog dismissed
states.description: Cancel, Esc, or backdrop resolves null; field stays empty, no toast.

states.name: Auto-sign offer
states.description: On load, if more than 5 auto-signable fields (name, initials, email, date) and action auth is not passkey/password/2FA: dialog listing counts per type, disclosure, Cancel/Sign.

states.name: Auto-sign submitting
states.description: Sign button loading while all fields sign in parallel via Promise.allSettled.

states.name: Auto-sign partial failure
states.description: Toast 'some fields may not be signed. Please review and manually sign any remaining fields.'; page revalidates showing mixed results.

states.name: Reauth method chooser
states.description: Multiple action-auth methods: 'Choose your preferred authentication method' list (Account/Passkey/2FA/Password); selected method shows a back chevron in the title.

states.name: Account login required
states.description: Warning alert 'To sign this field, you need to be logged in as {email}' (role/target variants), Cancel + Login that signs out and returns to this URL.
states.trigger: ACCOUNT action auth, user missing or mismatched

states.name: Password loading methods
states.description: Spinner while auth.getAuthMethods loads to decide if the user even has a password.

states.name: Password reauth form
states.description: 'Reauthentication is required to sign this field': password input (autocomplete current-password), Cancel/Sign.

states.name: Password unauthorized
states.description: Destructive alert 'Unauthorized / We were unable to verify your details. Please try again or contact support'. Form stays open.

states.name: No password set
states.description: OAuth/passkey-only user: neutral alert 'No password set' with PasswordSetupRequest to email a link, then come back. Close only.

states.name: Password auth unavailable
states.description: Instance has email/password sign-in disabled: warning 'Password authentication unavailable', contact sender.

states.name: Passkey unsupported browser
states.description: Warning 'Your browser does not support passkeys, which is required to sign this field.' Close only.

states.name: Passkeys loading
states.description: h-28 spinner while passkey list loads (also shown when error and list empty, before retry state).

states.name: Passkeys load error
states.description: Destructive alert 'Something went wrong while loading your passkeys.' with Cancel/Retry.

states.name: No passkeys, setup
states.description: Warning 'You need to setup a passkey to sign this field.' with Cancel and Setup (opens PasskeyCreateDialog, refetches on success).

states.name: Passkey select form
states.description: Select of passkeys (preferred preselected), Cancel/Sign; Sign triggers WebAuthn prompt with loading button.

states.name: Passkey prompt cancelled
states.description: User dismisses the OS passkey sheet (NotAllowedError): silently returns to the form, no alert.

states.name: Passkey verification failed
states.description: Destructive 'Unauthorized' alert under the select after a non-cancel failure.

states.name: 2FA not enabled
states.description: Warning 'You need to setup 2FA to sign this field' plus explanation, Close and EnableAuthenticatorAppDialog; on success switches to PIN form.

states.name: 2FA PIN form
states.description: 6-slot PinInput labelled '2FA token', Cancel/Sign.

states.name: 2FA code rejected
states.description: Destructive 'Unauthorized' alert below PIN; length validation 4-10 chars via FormMessage.

states.name: Reauth submitting locked
states.description: fieldset disabled, Sign button loading, dialog cannot be closed while isCurrentlyAuthenticating.

states.name: Complete confirmation
states.description: 'Are you sure?' with role copy ('You are about to complete signing the following document'), title card, disclosure, Cancel + Sign/Approve/Mark as Viewed. Only opens when all required fields are inserted.

states.name: Dictate next signer
states.description: Sequential + allowDictateNextSigner: Next Recipient Name/Email inputs prefilled with the default next recipient inside the confirm dialog.

states.name: Next signer invalid
states.description: 'Name is required' / 'Invalid email address' inline errors block submission.

states.name: Direct template identity
states.description: Direct-link templates with no recipient email: 'Your Name' / 'Your Email' inputs shown in the confirm dialog; email locked when provided by embed.

states.name: Completing, redirecting
states.description: Submit button loading, fieldset disabled, dialog locked; loading intentionally persists after success (isPending || isSuccess) until the full-page redirect lands.

states.name: Access 2FA choose method
states.description: Access auth TWO_FACTOR_AUTH: confirm dialog swaps to 'Choose verification method' (Email verification; Authenticator app only if user has it enabled).

states.name: Access 2FA requesting code
states.description: Method buttons disabled while request2FAEmail is pending; Resend code button shows loading later.

states.name: Access 2FA request failed
states.description: Toast 'An error occurred / We encountered an unknown error while attempting to request the two-factor authentication code.' Stays on method step.

states.name: Access 2FA code entry
states.description: Back arrow, 'Enter verification code', 6 large PIN slots (autofocus, numeric), 'Expires in mm:ss' countdown, Verify & Complete (disabled until 6 digits), Resend code for email.

states.name: Access 2FA code expired
states.description: Countdown reaches 00:00 and turns destructive; Verify button remains enabled (ambiguity: server rejects, user must Resend).

states.name: Access 2FA code invalid
states.description: TWO_FACTOR_AUTH_FAILED: form returns to method-selection with destructive alert 'Invalid verification code. Please try again.'

states.name: Completion error, specific
states.description: Destructive toast keyed by AppErrorCode: NOT_FOUND (link revoked), RECIPIENT_HAS_UNSIGNED_FIELDS (refresh and complete), RECIPIENT_OUT_OF_TURN, RECIPIENT_EXPIRED, ENVELOPE_COMPLETED, ENVELOPE_REJECTED, ENVELOPE_CANCELLED, ENVELOPE_DRAFT. Dialog stays open.

states.name: Completion error, generic
states.description: Fallback toast 'Something went wrong / We were unable to submit this document at this time. Please try again later.'
states.trigger: Unknown error code or network failure

states.name: Already signed toast
states.description: Result status ALREADY_SIGNED (retry, stale tab, double submit): neutral toast 'Document already signed', then continues to complete page.

states.name: TSP OAuth redirect
states.description: Certified (TSP) envelopes: completion returns status REDIRECT and the browser leaves for the credential-scope OAuth URL; no in-app feedback before navigation.

states.name: Reject dialog
states.description: 'Reject Document / Are you sure you want to reject this document? This action cannot be undone.' Reason textarea (optional), Cancel, destructive Reject Document.

states.name: Reject reason too long
states.description: Over 500 chars: FormMessage 'Reason must be less than 500 characters', submit disabled via !isValid.

states.name: Reject submitting
states.description: Textarea disabled, Cancel disabled, Reject button loading.

states.name: Reject success
states.description: Toast 'Document rejected / The document has been successfully rejected.' (5s), dialog closes, hard navigation to /rejected (or embed callback).

states.name: Reject error
states.description: Destructive toast 'An error occurred while rejecting the document. Please try again.' Dialog stays open with reason preserved.

states.name: Reject auto-opened
states.description: Email 'reject' link lands on /sign/:token?reject=true and the dialog opens on mount.

states.name: Rejection unavailable
states.description: Reject action hidden for direct templates and when embed sets allowDocumentRejection false; Actions block absent for templates.

states.name: CSC blocked
states.description: Terminal page with AlertTriangle and variant copy: no signing credentials, certificate invalid, algorithm not supported, or generic 'Unable to start the signing flow'; 'Try again' restarts service-scope OAuth.

states.name: CSC applying signature
states.description: Spinner, 'Applying your signature', 'Please don't close this tab. The signing provider is finalising your signature.' Auto-fires signEnvelope once on mount, then redirects to /complete.

states.name: CSC signing failed
states.description: 'Signing failed' with TSP timeout / SAD expired pre-sign / generic copy and 'Reauthorise and retry' link to credential-scope OAuth.

states.name: Signed, waiting for others
states.description: Title badge, SigningCard3D with signature, 'Document Signed', blue Clock8 'Waiting for others to sign', email-copy copy, Share button. Status polls every 3s.

states.name: Everyone has signed
states.description: Green CheckCircle 'Everyone has signed', 'You will receive an email copy', Download button appears. Can transition live from 127 via polling.

states.name: Processing document
states.description: Orange spinner 'Processing document', 'All recipients have signed. The document is being processed...' between last signature and sealed PDF.

states.name: Cancelled after signing
states.description: Red Clock8 'Document no longer available to sign', 'cancelled by the owner and is no longer available for others to sign.'

states.name: Claim account CTA
states.description: Non-user recipients get a second column 'Need to sign documents?' with ClaimAccount form prefilled with name/email; layout switches to two-column with divider at lg.
states.trigger: canSignUp (no existing user, email signup enabled)

states.name: Download available
states.description: Download button opens EnvelopeDownloadDialog once the document is completed; absent while pending.

states.name: Share button
states.description: DocumentShareButton always present after signing (social share card).

states.name: Role heading and home link
states.description: Heading 'Document Signed' / 'Document Viewed' / 'Document Approved' by role; logged-in users get 'Go Back Home' to their folder or /.

states.name: Assistant signer selection
states.description: Radio list of downstream signers with field counts and '(You)' tag; only the selected signer's non-signature fields are shown on the PDF.

states.name: Assistant confirmation
states.description: V1 'Continue' opens AssistantConfirmationDialog warning when uninserted fields remain; submitting state and completion error toast.

states.name: Assistant widget pre-expanded
states.description: Mobile widget mounts expanded for assistants so the signer picker is discoverable.

states.name: Attachments popover
states.description: 'Attachments (N)' button only when the envelope has attachments; popover lists external links with paperclip icon and hover ExternalLink. Nothing rendered while loading or empty.

states.name: Download PDF during signing
states.description: V2 Actions 'Download PDF' opens EnvelopeDownloadDialog for the unsigned copy.

states.name: First-time recipient
states.description: Almost every recipient is first-time and anonymous: no coach marks exist; orientation relies on sender line, field placeholders, Next Field and the legal disclosure paragraph shown in every signature/complete dialog.

states.name: Offline
states.description: No offline banner. Field insert fails to generic toast (48), completion fails to generic toast (114), PDF fetch fails to error state (16). Mobile recipients on flaky data will hit this.

states.name: Slow connection
states.description: Long PDF spinner with no progress; per-field spinner lingers; completion button spins until redirect. No timeouts or progress indicators.

states.name: Session expired mid-sign
states.description: ACCOUNT access/action auth docs: session lapses while filling; next signature click raises UNAUTHORIZED and the account reauth dialog (85) appears; completion would render the auth page on reload. Inserted fields persist server-side.

states.name: Link expires mid-session
states.description: Recipient deadline passes, or sender cancels/completes, while the tab is open: field/completion calls fail with RECIPIENT_EXPIRED / ENVELOPE_CANCELLED / ENVELOPE_COMPLETED toasts (113); reload lands on 5 or 6.

states.name: Responsive breakpoints
states.description: <md (V1) / <lg (V2): sidebar hidden, fixed bottom widget over the PDF with 7rem bottom padding; field text clamps 0.425-0.825rem via cqw; signature dialog pad shrinks; complete page stacks claim-account below. Desktop: sticky 350px / 320px sidebar.

states.name: Keyboard navigation
states.description: Field overlays are real buttons; dialogs trap focus; tabs have role=tab; PIN inputs autofocus. Gap: draw canvas has no keyboard alternative (Type tab is the fallback), color/zoom/undo buttons rely on focus-visible rings.

states.name: Screen reader
states.description: Signature img has alt 'Signature for {name}'; undo/zoom have sr-only labels; widget chevron has aria-label; 2FA PinInput has aria-label. Gaps: field overlay buttons have no accessible name, remaining-count changes and toasts are not announced via live region, 'Signature is too small' is visual only.

states.name: Reduced motion
states.description: framer-motion pen-stroke hint, spring hover, tab indicator, progress bar layout animation, widget slide-in and 3D signing card all animate regardless of prefers-reduced-motion.

states.name: High contrast
states.description: Field state is conveyed by recipient color (green/orange/readOnly) and muted placeholder text; pending vs done relies on color plus tooltip only.

states.name: Print
states.description: No print stylesheet; fixed widget/sidebar and field overlays would print over the PDF. Download (132/139) is the intended path.

clusters.name: Link Resolution
clusters.description: Server loader gating: 404, waiting, rejected, expired, cancelled, already-signed, redirect

clusters.name: Access Auth
clusters.description: Page-level ACCOUNT access requirement before the document is shown

clusters.name: Document Rendering
clusters.description: PDF viewer, header, branding, multi-file, other signers' fields

clusters.name: Signing Panel
clusters.description: Sidebar / mobile widget: progress, name and signature form, Next Field / Complete button

clusters.name: Field Insertion
clusters.description: Per-field overlay lifecycle: empty, flagged, inserting, inserted, remove, errors, read-only

clusters.name: Signature Pad
clusters.description: Draw / Type / Upload signature capture and its validation

clusters.name: Field Dialogs
clusters.description: Text, number, checkbox, dropdown value-entry dialogs

clusters.name: Action Auth
clusters.description: Re-authentication dialog on signature fields: account, password, passkey, 2FA

clusters.name: Completion
clusters.description: Confirm dialog, next-signer, access 2FA, submit, error taxonomy, TSP redirect

clusters.name: Completed Page
clusters.description: Post-signing page with live status polling, download, claim account

clusters.name: Assistant Role
clusters.description: Assistant fills fields on behalf of downstream signers
